verse.verse_1: ﻿In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
verse.verse_2: All praise is due to God, the Lord of the Universe;
verse.verse_4: Lord of the Day of Judgement.
verse.verse_5: You alone we worship, and to You alone we turn for help.
verse.verse_6: Guide us to the straight path:
verse.verse_7: the path of those You have blessed; not of those who have incurred Your wrath, nor of those who have gone astray.
